name: Quantara Tier Pricing for WooCommerce
author: Steit Slings

sections.description:
Quantara Tier Pricing for WooCommerce gives you full control over your pricing strategy by allowing you to set dynamic prices based on quantity or remaining stock.

This plugin helps you build urgency, boost order values, and increase sales with minimal effort. Perfect for flash sales, exclusive launches, or wholesale discounts — all with seamless cart integration.

Features in Quantara Tier Pricing

  • Bulk Discount Pricing – Offer tiered pricing based on quantity — e.g., Buy 3–5 for $10, 6–10 for $8.
  • Per-Product Configuration – Easily customise tiers and pricing for individual products
  • 3 Tiers per product – Three free tiers for all your simple products
  • Cart & Checkout Integration – Pricing updates automatically in the WooCommerce cart and checkout. Customers see clear, real-time price adjustments.

Upgrade to Quantara Advanced Tier Pricing

A premium version with advanced features is available.

Features in Advanced versions

  • All from the Free version – Get everything from the Free version.
  • Tiers on Variants – Get tiers on variable products per variant. i.e. have 3 tiers for a blue version and 5 for a red version of your product. [All premium versions]
  • Stock-Based Pricing – Set different price levels depending on how much stock remains. Prices can automatically increase or decrease as inventory sells out. [All Premium]
  • Scarcity-Driven Sales Model – Encourage fast action from buyers by increasing prices as stock decreases. Perfect for limited-edition items or time-sensitive offers. Create the FOMO effect on your products! [Pro]
  • Show price buildup – Show price buildup in the cart on tier crossing within the order. [Pro & Expert]
  • Hide expired or future tiers – Hide tiers that are not available anymore or not available yet. Prevent users from waiting for upcoming discounts. [Expert]

Use Cases

  • Exclusive product launches
  • Wholesale pricing for bulk buyers
  • Early-bird specials
  • Limited stock promotions
  • B2B quantity discounts

sections.installation:
Free & Premium installation

  1. In your WordPress admin panel, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Click Upload Plugin and choose the .zip file you downloaded.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. After activation, you’ll be prompted to connect your site to receive automatic updates and support — follow the on-screen onboarding flow.
  5. Go to WooCommerce → Products to configure pricing tiers on your products.
  6. Adjust global plugin settings under WooCommerce → Woo Tier Pricing.
sections.faq:
Does it work with variable products?

Yes! You can set pricing rules for each variation individually with the Premium versions.

Can I mix quantity and stock-based pricing?

Absolutely. You can combine both to create highly flexible pricing strategies.

Will it work with other cart or pricing plugins?

Quantara Tier Pricing for WooCommerce is designed to integrate directly with the WooCommerce cart. Conflicts are rare, but we recommend testing with third-party pricing tools.

Will it work with other currencies?

Yes, Quantara Tier Pricing for WooCommerce uses the WooCommerce standard functionality to calculate exchange rates. In some rare occasions when using the scarcity model, the cart integration breakdown may show a few cents rounding differences. Quantara Tier Pricing for WooCommerce calculates the average price when ordering across tiers.

What if I run into issues?

Contact me via the contact form.
